one_liner: A Hyperfy app that lets users set a ROM name and pick a color, then adjusts mesh UVs; includes a known material‑linking bug.
primary_use_case: Configure visual appearance of a ROM model via UI controls and apply UV texture offsets based on selected color.
preview_recommendation: Use the primary screenshot (p3_Screenshot_2025-03-28_at_9.28.05_AM.png) as the preview; it clearly shows the UI and model, despite being a fallback author.
manifest_quality_notes: Fallback preview used due to any‑author fallback
Material linking bug documented in script comments
No networking or server‑side logic present
Asset URLs are internal to the .hyp bundle
